notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
Just a round of bug fixes!

- Fix a bug causing certain blocks to inconsistently show up, but have no collision (Thanks to those who submitted workshop levels with this issue that gave me a consistent repro)
- Adjusted Buttons and More Buttons level slightly, to make one section with the rising death block slightly more clear in how to approach it
- Fixed some funky camera issues with looking up and down, and doing so when going straight into a level versus using the level editor
- Fixed an issue where you could get stuck crouching

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Another small list of changes

[list]
[*] Removed some levels from the tutorial section, I didn't feel they were actually helpful for being part of the tutorials and were more frustrating rather than fun. May rerelease them on the workshop in the future.
[*] Adjusted "to slide" to feel a bit less frustrating when just using basic controls
[*] Removed another accidental duplicate level
[*] Crouching was a bit too sensitive, so I adjusted the threshold to avoid accidental crouching
[*] Another guess fix for pause not working on controller
[*] (Editor) Timers would previously start working their logic as soon as you placed them into the level, and this could cause all sorts of weird things to break. I've removed that.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Hey there! Thanks for the warm welcome, and I hope all are enjoying Luminus so far. A small patch today for some small quality of life updates. I have a number of small features I want to focus on in the future.

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- Added a vsync option. It should default on, though if you've already started playing it will be off to begin with.
- Added the ability to hold up or down to look up and down.
- There was a duplicate level for "To move with purpose". I've deleted the incorrect version.
- Adjusted some settings to hopefully fix a potential issue with pausing on controller.
- Using the D-pad now works with controllers; due to technical issues, you will have to go into your keybinds and hit "reset" for this to work, if you've already been playing.
- Fixed an issue where spam clicking a button would get the art stuck in a smaller version of it.

That's all for now folks! I have some changes coming, and I'm planning to continually post new levels to the Steam workshop, and I hope to see yours!
